description: Mounted on a pylon in Gimli, a legacy of RCAF Station Gimli. This airframe belly landed on 6 May 1957 after an engine flame-out caused by a failed fuel pump on take-off from Portage la Prairie; both crew walked away. The monument was taken down for repairs in 2016 and returned. Earlier RCAF serial 21239.
museum_name: Gimli CT-133 Silver Star Monument, Gimli
